check_customer.name: check_customer
check_customer.description: Look up the caller in the business's customer database by phone number.

check_availability.name: check_availability
check_availability.description: Check the business owner's calendar for available appointment slots.

book_appointment.name: book_appointment
book_appointment.description: Create an appointment on the business owner's calendar.

start_time.description: Start time in ISO 8601 with the business owner's timezone offset. Copy start_iso from check_availability. Never use Z.

end_time.description: End time in ISO 8601 with the business owner's timezone offset. Copy end_iso from check_availability. Never use Z.

cancel_service_request.name: cancel_service_request
cancel_service_request.description: Cancel an existing service request after the caller clearly asks to cancel it. Report success only when the tool result says the change was applied.

request_id.description: ID of the caller's current service request. Do not guess it.

expected_revision.description: Current request revision from trusted customer context.

reschedule_service_request.name: reschedule_service_request
reschedule_service_request.description: Move an existing service request to a caller-confirmed date and time. Report success only when the tool result says the change was applied.

request_id.description: ID of the caller's current service request. Do not guess it.

expected_revision.description: Current request revision from trusted customer context.

scheduled_start.description: Caller-confirmed new start time in ISO 8601 format.

scheduled_end.description: Caller-confirmed new end time in ISO 8601 format.

add_service_to_request.name: add_service_to_request
add_service_to_request.description: Add one caller-requested service to an existing service request. Report success only when the tool result says the change was applied.

request_id.description: ID of the caller's current service request. Do not guess it.

expected_revision.description: Current request revision from trusted customer context.

service.description: The additional service requested by the caller.

anthropic_jobber.name: check_customer
anthropic_jobber.description: Look up the caller in the business's customer database by phone number. Returns customer name and address if found.

phone.description: The caller's phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234)

anthropic_calendar.name: check_availability
anthropic_calendar.description: Check the business owner's Google Calendar for available appointment slots in the next 7 days.

days_ahead.description: Number of days ahead to check (default 7, max 14)

anthropic_calendar.name: book_appointment
anthropic_calendar.description: Create an appointment on the business owner's Google Calendar.

title.description: Short description of the appointment (e.g. 'Faucet repair - John Smith')

start_time.description: Start time in ISO 8601 with the business owner's timezone offset. Copy start_iso from check_availability when available. Never use Z; 12pm Eastern is 2026-08-21T12:00:00-04:00, not 12:00:00Z.

end_time.description: End time in ISO 8601 with the business owner's timezone offset. Copy end_iso from check_availability when available. Never use Z.
